title: Rights & Responsibilities
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Things every child should have — and the jobs we all must do to help each other!
source: NSC Practice — built from the official MOE Grade 2 curriculum
nscObjectives: Identify the basic rights of children
Identify responsibilities at home, at school, and in the community
Understand the difference between a right and a responsibility

sections.title: Children's Rights
sections.description: A RIGHT is something every child should have to be safe, healthy, and happy.

questions.prompt: A RIGHT is something every child...
questions.hint: Rights belong to EVERY child — no one has to earn them

questions.prompt: Select ALL the things that are children's RIGHTS:
options: a new video game every week
questions.hint: Rights are things you NEED — not everything you WANT

questions.prompt: Every child has the right to learn. That is why every child can go to ___.
questions.hint: Education is a right for all children in Jamaica

questions.prompt: When you are sick, you have the right to...
questions.hint: Health care is a right — clinics and hospitals help children get well

questions.prompt: Children also have the right to PLAY. Why is play important?
options: It helps children grow strong, learn, and make friends
It is a waste of time
questions.correct: It helps children grow strong, learn, and make friends
questions.hint: Playing is how children exercise their bodies AND brains!

questions.prompt: Which of these is a WANT, not a right?
questions.hint: You NEED water, safety, and food — fancy sneakers are nice but not needed

questions.prompt: Every child has the right to a name and a country. In Jamaica, this is shown on your...
questions.hint: It's the special paper with your name and birthday from when you were born

sections.title: My Responsibilities
sections.description: A RESPONSIBILITY is a job or duty — something we SHOULD do to help ourselves and others.

options: a job or duty we should do
questions.correct: a job or duty we should do
questions.hint: Like tidying your room or doing homework — things that are YOUR job

questions.prompt: Select ALL your responsibilities at HOME:
questions.hint: Responsibilities are helpful jobs — TV all day doesn't help anyone!

questions.prompt: Select ALL your responsibilities at SCHOOL:
questions.hint: Library books must be cared for — scribbling hurts them!

questions.prompt: You have the RIGHT to go to school. What is your RESPONSIBILITY at school?
options: to do your best and follow the rules
questions.correct: to do your best and follow the rules
questions.hint: Rights come with responsibilities — school is a gift, so do your part!

questions.prompt: Your friend drops their crayons all over the floor. A responsible classmate would...
questions.hint: Being responsible means helping others when they need it

questions.prompt: Match each place to a responsibility you have there:
questions.hint: Beds are at home, hands go up in class, bins keep Jamaica clean!

sections.title: Rights and Responsibilities Together
sections.description: Every right comes with a responsibility. Let's put them together!

questions.prompt: Match each RIGHT to the RESPONSIBILITY that goes with it:

options: keep your body clean and exercise
keep your body clean and exercise
pairs.correct: keep your body clean and exercise

options: keep your body clean and exercise

questions.hint: Each right has a matching duty — learning needs homework, health needs hygiene, play needs sharing

questions.prompt: You have the right to share your ideas. What responsibility goes with it?
options: listening when OTHERS share their ideas
questions.correct: listening when OTHERS share their ideas
questions.hint: If you want to be heard, you must also listen!

questions.prompt: Everyone has the right to a clean community. What is YOUR responsibility?
questions.hint: Keep Jamaica clean and beautiful — bins are everywhere for a reason!

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows BOTH a right AND a responsibility?
options: I can borrow library books, and I return them on time.
I take toys and never give them back.
I let my pet go hungry.
questions.correct: I can borrow library books, and I return them on time.
questions.hint: Borrowing is the right; returning on time is the responsibility!

questions.prompt: Type the missing word: 'A job or duty that I should do is called a respon______.'
questions.hint: respon + sibility — the big word for a duty!

questions.prompt: Morgan waters the class plant every Friday without being reminded. Morgan is being...
questions.hint: Doing your duty without being told — that's responsibility! 🌱
